_about: Licence ledger for the sample photos the Smart UI picture fixtures hotlink from images.unsplash.com (the photos the Smart UI demo uses). Each was looked at for brand marks and given alt text from what it shows. Unsplash's robots.txt blocks AI crawlers, so the photo pages were not opened: the photographer and page are 'not confirmed' until a person checks them on unsplash.com. The earlier Openverse and Wikimedia coat files were dropped.
